exposure: patients with RPOC requiring hemostatic procedures
cohort: 323 patients with RPOC without placenta previa at 186 Japanese perinatal centers
finding: Patients with RPOC were significantly more likely to require transfusion at delivery if they had large RPOC or conceived through ART, and were more likely to require hemostatic procedures for subsequent bleeding if they had hypervascular RPOC or conceived through ART.
